title: Persona Contact List — payload
description: Enumerate contacts in a context, optionally narrowed to those known by one persona. Summaries only; documents are fetched one at a time.

knownByPersona.description: Narrow to contacts known by this persona. Omitting it lists the context's contacts across every persona in it, which a producer SHOULD offer deliberately rather than by default — the unfiltered view is the one that shows the holder's personas side by side.

changedSince.description: Return only contacts whose current revision was received after this instant. The cheap way to answer "what changed while I was away", which is the question the revision history exists to make answerable.

Response.title: Persona Contact List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to persona/contact/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/persona/contact/list/1.0#response. Summaries carry no claim values: a list is for finding a contact, and finding one does not require disclosing every contact's details.

displayName.description: A rendering hint drawn from the contact's own disclosed display-name claim, so a list is legible. Absent when they disclosed none; a producer MUST NOT substitute the DID silently as though it were a name.

hasUnreviewedChange.description: True when the current revision superseded another and the holder has not yet acknowledged the difference. This is what lets a producer badge a contact whose payment address moved — the whole point of keeping revisions.
